title: UUID Request Input and Migration Failure Events in Laravel 13.42
content:
Laravel 13.42 adds uuid() and ulid() input helpers, a MigrationFailed event, skip reasons for scheduled tasks, and Uri::origin() for comparing URL origins.

The post UUID Request Input and Migration Failure Events in Laravel 13.42 appeared first on Laravel News.
